svg.title: Figure 7-1. Hazard log: what reaches each hazard, and what holds it (WP-C-03 §7)
svg.desc: 9 cards, one per hazard of WP-C-03. H-01 Unintended or excessive lateral motion: goals SG-01; 14 FSRs, 5 implemented. H-02 Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control: goals SG-01, SG-02; 28 FSRs, 7 implemented. H-03 Unintended acceleration: goals SG-03; 13 FSRs, 4 implemented. H-04 Unintended or excessive deceleration: goals SG-04; 14 FSRs, 4 implemented. H-05 Driver unable to override or disengage: goals SG-05; 12 FSRs, 5 implemented. H-06 Unannounced loss of longitudinal deceleration: goals SG-06; 16 FSRs, 3 implemented. H-07 Displayed system state differs from actual state (mode confusion): goals SG-02, SG-06; 21 FSRs, 3 implemented. H-08 Suppression of the vehicle's stock pre-collision braking: goals SG-07; 10 FSRs, 3 implemented. H-09 Automated control continues with a driver who is not supervising or not responding: goals SG-08; 5 FSRs, 1 implemented.
svg.text: Hazard log · what reaches each hazard, and what holds it
